metadata.name: CASO-RAG Evaluation Benchmark Dataset
metadata.description: Standardized evaluation dataset containing true knowledge sources, distractor corpus, and benchmark questions for measuring Hit@1, Recall@3, and Distractor Noise Rejection Rate.

corpus.title: Biography of Steve Jobs
corpus.text: Steve Jobs was an American entrepreneur and inventor best known as the co-founder of Apple Inc. He was born in San Francisco, California. Apple was founded in 1976 to sell Wozniak's Apple I personal computer.

corpus.title: California Apple Orchard Report 1976
corpus.text: In 1976, apple orchards across Northern California and San Francisco reported record harvests of red delicious apples sold in local markets and farm stands.

corpus.title: Steve Wozniak Engineering Notes
corpus.text: The Apple I personal computer was designed and hand-built by Steve Wozniak. It utilized the MOS Technology 6502 microprocessor running at 1 MHz with 4 KB of standard RAM.

corpus.title: History of Python
corpus.text: Python is a high-level programming language conceived in the late 1980s by Guido van Rossum at CWI in the Netherlands. It was officially released in 1991.

corpus.title: Monty Python British Comedy
corpus.text: Monty Python was a British surreal comedy troupe formed in 1969. Their sketch show aired on the BBC and influenced modern comedy across Europe and the Netherlands.

corpus.title: Neo4j Graph Architecture
corpus.text: Neo4j is a native graph database that stores data as nodes and relationships rather than tables. It uses the declarative Cypher query language for multi-hop graph traversals.

corpus.title: Qdrant Vector Engine
corpus.text: Qdrant is a high-performance vector similarity search engine written in Rust. It uses Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) indexes and cosine distance for fast nearest-neighbor retrieval.
